integrity: Exact algebraic proof plus independent small-field full enumerations and a standalone polynomial identity checker. No independent external validation or absolute historical priority is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite-field radical-square-zero path algebras of loopless simple graphs; one-sided explicit transfer currently cycles; the general-graph closed formula applies to mutual annihilation only. Full-text comparison with a 2022 finite-ring zero-probability article was unavailable and remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Orientation-sensitive zero products and orientation-invariant mutual annihilation in truncated cycle algebras
